title: I didn't ... Did you ...? (past simple negative and questions)
summary: Отрицание и вопросы в past simple строятся с **did**: **I didn't watch ... Did you watch ...?** — основной глагол в начальной форме.
ru:
## Один вспомогательный глагол на всё прошедшее
В past simple для отрицаний и вопросов нужен **did** (для **всех** лиц), а основной глагол **возвращается к начальной форме**.
> I watched TV. → I **didn't watch** TV. — Я не смотрел телевизор.
> They went home. → **Did** they **go** home? — Они ушли домой?

## Отрицание: didn't + глагол
**didn't** = did not. Для всех: I / you / he / she / it / we / they.
> I **didn't watch** TV yesterday.
> She **didn't have** time. — У неё не было времени.
> We **didn't enjoy** the film. — Нам не понравился фильм.
Глагол остаётся в начальной форме: прошедшее время уже показано в **didn't**.
> ~~I didn't watched.~~ → I didn't **watch**.
> ~~He didn't went.~~ → He didn't **go**.

## Вопрос: Did + подлежащее + глагол
> **Did** you **see** Joe yesterday? — Ты видел Джо вчера?
> **Did** your sister **phone** you? — Твоя сестра тебе звонила?
> What **did** you **do** yesterday evening? — Что ты делал вчера вечером?
> Where **did** your parents **go** for their holiday? — Куда ездили твои родители в отпуск?
> How **did** the accident **happen**? — Как произошёл несчастный случай?

## Краткие ответы
> Did you see Joe? — **Yes, I did.** / **No, I didn't.**
> Did it rain on Sunday? — **Yes, it did.** / **No, it didn't.**
> Did Helen come? — **Yes, she did.** / **No, she didn't.**
Повторяем только **did**.

## Сравните: present и past
| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| I **don't** watch TV. | I **didn't** watch TV. |
| **Does** she go away? | **Did** she go away? |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I didn't went there.~~ → I didn't **go** there.
- ~~Did you went?~~ → Did you **go**?
- ~~Did she saw him?~~ → Did she **see** him?
- ~~You saw Joe yesterday?~~ → **Did** you **see** Joe yesterday?
- ~~I wasn't have time.~~ → I **didn't have** time.
en:
## One helper for the whole past
In the past simple, we use **did** in negatives and questions (for **all** subjects). The main verb goes back to the **infinitive** (base form).
> I watched TV. → I **didn't watch** TV.
> They went home. → **Did** they **go** home?

## Negative: didn't + verb
**didn't** = did not. It is the same for I / you / he / she / it / we / they.
> I **didn't watch** TV yesterday.
> She **didn't have** time.
> We **didn't enjoy** the film.
The verb stays in the base form:
> ~~I didn't watched.~~ → I didn't **watch**.
> ~~He didn't went.~~ → He didn't **go**.

## Question: Did + subject + verb
> **Did** you **see** Joe yesterday?
> **Did** your sister **phone** you?
> What **did** you **do** yesterday evening?
> Where **did** your parents **go** for their holiday?

## Short answers
> Did you see Joe? — **Yes, I did.** / **No, I didn't.**
> Did it rain on Sunday? — **Yes, it did.** / **No, it didn't.**
We use only **did**.

## Compare
| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| I **don't** watch TV. | I **didn't** watch TV. |
| **Does** she go away? | **Did** she go away? |

## Common mistakes
- ~~I didn't went there.~~ → I didn't **go** there.
- ~~Did you went?~~ → Did you **go**?
- ~~Did she saw him?~~ → Did she **see** him?
structure:
## Утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
| | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Утверждение | Подлежащее + **глагол в past** | She **watched** TV. · He **went** home. |
| Отрицание | Подлежащее + **didn't** + глагол | She **didn't watch** TV. · He **didn't go** home. |
| Вопрос | **Did** + подлежащее + глагол? | **Did** she **watch** TV? · **Did** he **go** home? |
| Вопрос со словом | Слово + **did** + подлежащее + глагол? | What **did** she **watch**? · Where **did** he **go**? |

## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Did I / you / he / she / it / we / they ...? | Yes, I / you / he / she / it / we / they **did**. | No, I / you / he / she / it / we / they **didn't**. |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + **didn't** + глагол (начальная форма)
> **Did** + подлежащее + глагол (начальная форма)**?**

## do / does → did
| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| don't / doesn't | **didn't** |
| Do / Does ...? | **Did** ...? |

## Важно
- После **did / didn't** глагол **без** -ed и без особой формы: *didn't **go***, *Did you **see***.
- С **be** (was / were) did не нужен: *I **wasn't** there. **Were** you there?* (см. unit 10).

exercises.title: Отрицание
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в отрицательной форме (**didn't + глагол**).

items.text: I saw Barbara but I {{didn't see|did not see}} Jane.
They worked on Monday but they {{didn't work|did not work}} on Tuesday.
We went to the post office but we {{didn't go|did not go}} to the bank.
She had a pen but she {{didn't have|did not have}} any paper.
Jack did French at school but he {{didn't do|did not do}} German.
The film was boring. We {{didn't enjoy|did not enjoy}} it.

exercises.title: Вопросы с Did
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в скобках: **did** и основной глагол в нужной форме.

items.text: Where {{did}} your parents {{go}} for their holiday?

items.q: I ___ the film. It was boring.
We ___ to the party because we were ill.

items.why: С be did не используем: **Where were you?**

exercises.title: Задайте вопрос с Did
exercises.instruction: Задайте вопрос о вчерашнем дне по образцу.
exercises.example: I watched TV last night. And you? → **Did you watch TV last night?**

items.prompt: I enjoyed the party. And you?
I had a good holiday. And you?
answers: Did you have a good holiday?

items.prompt: I finished work early. And you?
I slept well last night. And you?
answers: Did you sleep well last night?

items.prompt: I went to the shop. And your brother?
answers: Did your brother go to the shop?

items.prompt: I bought a new phone. And Tom?
answers: Did Tom buy a new phone?
I did not watch TV yesterday.
I did not watch television yesterday.
Did you go to the shop yesterday?
Did you go to the store yesterday?
What did you do on Sunday?

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Did you go out last night?
items.sample: No, I didn't. I stayed at home.

items.prompt: What did you do last weekend?
items.sample: I met my friends and we went to the park.

items.prompt: Did you sleep well last night?
items.sample: Yes, I did. I slept very well.

items.prompt: Что вы НЕ сделали вчера, хотя хотели?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
items.sample: I went to Issyk-Kul with my family.
